title: Twitch streamer SukiMellow has police called on her after Apple Pay prank on elderly couple
summary_full: Twitch streamer SukiMellow faced significant online backlash after a prank video surfaced.  The video showed her startling an elderly woman with a loud notification sound.  The frightened woman repeatedly called for police assistance and asked for her phone.  Another concerned woman intervened and began recording the streamer's actions.  SukiMellow and her cameraman then walked away laughing from the situation.
